 The K-Beauty Products ELLE Korea Says Are Worth Your Attention 
 The K-Beauty Products ELLE Korea Says Are Worth Your Attention 
 The sunscreens, essences, and moisturizers that editors and beauty experts use themselves.
 By The Editors Published: Nov 9, 2026 Save Article Share Article Every item on this page was chosen by an ELLE editor. We may earn commission on some of the items you choose to buy. 
 1 min read The most exciting country in the world right now for beauty innovation is Korea . Whether it’s a skin-tightening treatment that every celebrity seems to be trying or serums in delightful formats like bubbles and heart-shaped patches, K-beauty is the star of the beauty industry. Our colleagues at ELLE Korea have watched it rise firsthand. In an endless sea of K-beauty products, it takes an expert’s keen eye to spot the true gems. From skin care to makeup and fragrance, they’ve compiled their absolute must-haves.
 Here are the best K-beauty products, as picked by editors at ELLE Korea and their favorite beauty experts.
 Best Recovery Serum Rejuran Turnover Ampoule c-PDRN 0.5% Renewing Serum
 Best Recovery Serum Rejuran Turnover Ampoule c-PDRN 0.5% Renewing Serum
 $52 Amazon “This is hands down the best companion when intensive recovery is needed in post-laser treatment. The active ingredients extracted from salmon DNA assist with the skin cell turnover cycle, fostering the skin’s natural strength from within. With continuous use, you can expect noticeable improvements, as skin density and elasticity become significantly firmer.”— Dr. Sujung Yoon, family medicine specialist at Yoon Sujung Clinic 
 Best Regenerating Serum The Whoo Bichup Self-Generating NAD Power Ampoule
 Best Regenerating Serum The Whoo Bichup Self-Generating NAD Power Ampoule
 Now 10% Off $139 $125 oliveyoung.com “This ampoule smartly boosts the skin’s inherent self-regenerating power utilizing NAD, a core fuel for skin cells. The seamless, fast-absorbing texture firmly rebuilds a compromised skin barrier while leaving rough skin texture and fine lines smooth and hydrated. It is the perfect choice for balancing moisture and nourishment during the summer months without any worry of breakouts.”— Dr. Suhyun Lee, dermatologist at Pure Dermatology Clinic 
 HWANG BYUNG MOON Best Leave-In Hair Treatment Healing Bird Hyaluron Milk Hair Mist Hydrating Spray
 Best Leave-In Hair Treatment Healing Bird Hyaluron Milk Hair Mist Hydrating Spray
 $19 Ulta Beauty “This product didn’t just coat the surface of the hair, but truly nourished it from within to refine the texture. Because of its soft, milky consistency, it absorbs quickly, meaning you can reapply it multiple times before and after styling without it getting greasy or leaving any residue on your hands.”— Jihye Oh, hairstylist 
 Best Colored Contact Lenses Hapa Kristin Contact Lenses in Black
 Best Colored Contact Lenses Hapa Kristin Contact Lenses in Black
 Now 50% Off $44 $22 hapakristin.com “The effect of these lenses is captivating—it creates a sharp, defined outer ring while keeping the inner color beautifully clear and translucent. This unique payoff delivers doll-like, round, and striking eyes, making it the perfect choice when you want to give your overall look a definitive pop.”— Jungin Im, makeup artist [Editor’s Note: Contacts require a prescription in the U.S. from a licensed eye doctor.]
 HWANG BYUNG MOON Best Calming Sunscreen iUNIK Centella Calming Daily Sun Water
 Best Calming Sunscreen iUNIK Centella Calming Daily Sun Water
 Now 20% Off $8 $6 Yesstyle “With its hydrating, water-like formula, this sun care product gives a fresh and lightweight application, even over large body areas. It doesn’t have the heavy feel of mineral sunscreens and the potential skin sensitivity issue with chemical ones, making it effortless to apply generously, without any burden.”— Eunju Lee, full-time skin care professor at Yeonsung University’s Department of Beauty Stylist 
 Best Hydrating Sunscreen Goodal Heartleaf Soothing Moisture Sunscreen
 Best Hydrating Sunscreen Goodal Heartleaf Soothing Moisture Sunscreen
 $24 oliveyoung.com “With a smooth texture that feels just like applying a moisturizing cream, this sunscreen goes on evenly for everyone, without pilling. Its quick absorption completely eliminates any sticky finish, leaving nothing but deep hydration. It is particularly ideal for dry skin types that frequently experience roughness.”— Jungeun Park, director of Comme Nana Bien 
 HWANG BYUNG MOON 
 Best Lightweight Foundation Fwee All-Day Cover Black Cushion
 Best Lightweight Foundation Fwee All-Day Cover Black Cushion
 Now 15% Off $26 $22 Yesstyle “This is a great product for completing your base makeup during the warmer months. Even when swept on quickly with your fingers instead of tools, it wraps smoothly around the skin. I love that it delivers reliable coverage despite its lightweight, thin texture.”— Seyoung Ahn, makeup artist 
 Best SPF Foundation Giverny Milchak Cover Foundation 30ml
 Best SPF Foundation Giverny Milchak Cover Foundation 30ml
 Now 15% Off $39 $33 oliveyoung.com “I love this foundation which naturally conceals redness and blemishes with just a single thin layer, eliminating the need for heavy reapplication. I was highly impressed by how it blends into a gorgeous glow even as natural oils break through over time.”— Sol Lee, makeup artist 
 Best Concealer Tense Clean Moment Dayproof Concealer
 Best Concealer Tense Clean Moment Dayproof Concealer
 $16 musinsa.com “The lightweight, smooth sensation the moment this concealer touches the skin is incredible. Thanks to its outstanding adherence, it seamlessly melts in. It is absolute perfection for achieving a clean, natural-looking coverage that feels like your own skin without sitting on the surface.”— Miyoung Ko, director of Artistry Chacha 
 Best Foundation for Redness Clio Kill Cover Founwear Cushion Foundation
 Best Foundation for Redness Clio Kill Cover Founwear Cushion Foundation
 $25 Amazon Also Consider $29 Nordstrom “This cushion compact boasts exceptional coverage that smoothly hides redness and pores even when worn entirely on its own. The soft, semi-matte formula adheres flawlessly without drying out dehydrated-combination skin, and it melts naturally into the skin without caking, even when natural skin oils surface later in the day. Applying a thin initial layer and lightly tapping creates skin coverage without any heavy feeling.”— Subin Kim, director of Salon Hearts 
 HWANG BYUNG MOON 
 Best Spicy Perfume Kuoca Dark Tea
 Best Spicy Perfume Kuoca Dark Tea
 $130 luckyscent.com “A clear black tea scent and the exotic, woody, and spicy aroma of Marrakesh captured in a bottle reminiscent of a wine glass.”— Jung Youn Ji, ELLE Korea beauty director 
 Best Scalp Scrub Aromatica Rosemary Salt Scrub Shampoo at Nordstrom
 Best Scalp Scrub Aromatica Rosemary Salt Scrub Shampoo at Nordstrom
 $35 Nordstrom “A salt scrub shampoo that delivers the refreshing exfoliating power of Andean salt alongside the revitalizing energy of rosemary.”— JYJ 
 Best Cream Toner Laneige Cream Skin Cerapeptide Refiner
 Best Cream Toner Laneige Cream Skin Cerapeptide Refiner
 Now 32% Off $37 $25 Yesstyle “Formulated by melting Cerapeptide cream into a toner to care for elasticity and the skin barrier from the very first step of your routine.”— JYJ 
 Best Skin Care Device LG Superform Galvanic Booster
 Best Skin Care Device LG Superform Galvanic Booster
 $75 palacebeauty.com “This tool maximizes skincare absorption utilizing an optimal galvanic microcurrent.”— JYJ 
 Best Moisturizer Sulwhasoo Concentrated Ginseng Rejuvenating Cream Rich
 Best Moisturizer Sulwhasoo Concentrated Ginseng Rejuvenating Cream Rich
 $260 Amazon Also Consider $260 Macy's $160 Nordstrom “My moisturizer pick harnesses powerful ginseng energy to rebuild a compromised skin barrier and boost the skin for a firmer, high-density complexion.”— JYJ
